nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Tình huống khẩn · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại mất ví giữa hai người bạn
L: What? Are you sure? Check your bag again.
I did. It's not here. I had it at the bus stop.
Okay, calm down. Did you take anything out of your bag there?
Yes! I took out my student card. Maybe my wallet fell out then.
Let's go back to the bus stop and look for it.
My ID and bank card are in it. I'm so stressed.
Wait, call your bank first and block the card, just in case.
You're right. I'll call them right now.
Don't worry. Someone might have found it and handed it in.

exq.q: Where did Emma last have her wallet?
exq.why: “I had it at the bus stop.” = ví còn ở trạm xe buýt.

exq.q: What does Jake tell Emma to do first?
exq.a: Call her bank and block the card
exq.why: “call your bank first and block the card” = gọi ngân hàng trước, khoá thẻ.

exq.q: What did Emma take out at the bus stop?
exq.why: “I took out my student card.” = lấy thẻ sinh viên ra.

exq.q: What does Jake think might have happened?
exq.a: Someone found the wallet and handed it in
exq.why: “Someone might have found it and handed it in.” = ai đó có thể đã nhặt và nộp lại.
